system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Each agent is a self-contained markdown playbook (`## User Prompt` methodology + `## System Prompt` strict anti-false-positive rules).
system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent markdown system prompts selected by recon plus objective/out-of-scope injected into every agent prompt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: before the model recon, the harness runs a **real** request/response analysis ... and feeds those observed facts into recon
env_context_strategy.note: Deterministic HTTP probe injects facts + agents navigate with curl/nmap tools.

context_compaction.note: No history-processing/condenser code shown in evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: agents capture visual proof per finding (`evidence/<finding-id>-N.png`)
observation_format.note: Empirical raw tool output plus proof screenshots; Playwright browser.

tool_call_format.note: Parser turning model output into actions not shown; agents drive CLIs/MCP.

tool_count.note: No explicit tool schema list in evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: strictly non-destructive (no data loss, no DB overwrite, no DoS)
edit_primitive.note: Pentest harness; no file-editing primitive, only writes PoCs to pocs/.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Enable Playwright MCP (auto-provisioned via `npx`; backends without MCP use built-in tools).
tool_schema_source.note: Agent playbooks are hand-written markdown; MCP schemas via Playwright.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Enable Playwright MCP (auto-provisioned via `npx`; backends without MCP use built-in tools).

loop_primitives.note: Fixed pipeline default; cross-model voting panel = multi_attempt.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: a property-graph **belief** carries probabilities, and "scan more vs exploit now" falls out of belief entropy
planning_granularity.note: Orchestrator + belief graph but no stored discrete plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: intelligently selects only the agents that match the discovered surface**, runs them in parallel
multi_agent_topology.note: meta/orchestrator.md selects and runs specialist agents; validator adjudicates.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: runs them in parallel, **chains** findings into deeper
delegation_mechanism.note: Orchestrator spawns specialist agents per surface.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Agents are instructed to stay in scope, never run destructive/DoS actions, and require proof-of-exploitation.
human_in_loop.note: Interactive REPL/composer allows steering but no per-action approval gate shown.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Per-project memory** — `<cwd>/.neurosploit/` keeps session, run history and command history
long_term_memory.note: RL reward store data/rl_state_rs.json biases future runs (episodic).

self_verification.evidence_quote: validates every claim by cross-model voting + tool-receipt grounding** before reporting
self_verification.note: attacker→LLM-judge loop, exploit_validator, false_positive_filter meta agents.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: How many models must agree a finding is real (default 3 / 2 for whitebox).
retry_policy.note: Voting is not task-level retry; no retry loop shown.

rollback.evidence_quote: strictly non-destructive (no data loss, no DB overwrite, no DoS)
rollback.note: No revert/rollback of target changes; harness does not modify target files.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Cap agents run (`0` = all matching the recon).
termination_condition.note: --max-agents caps agents; run completes to report; Ctrl-C → report.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: First = primary; the rest fail over **and** form the voting jury.
cost_controls.note: Token/cost telemetry present but not a hard cap; RL-weighted selection.

timeouts.note: No timeout configuration shown in evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: every action spawns the real compiled CLI and parses its output
execution_isolation.note: Runs on host; Kali Docker image recommended but optional.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: run the whole engagement on your box with **no API key** and **no data leaving the host**
filesystem_access.note: Runs on host with full filesystem access.

network_policy.evidence_quote: routes agent traffic through your local intercepting proxy
network_policy.note: Pentest tool making outbound requests to targets; no egress restriction.

permission_model.evidence_quote: give the goal/context and hard exclusions in words (`/objective`, `/scope-out`

tracing.note: Per-run folder with status.json, recon.json, findings.json.

replayability.evidence_quote: an in-progress run reattaches to the same live stream instead of resetting
replayability.note: Session/run resume; no bit-for-bit trajectory replay claimed.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Exercise the full pipeline without calling any model.
eval_hooks.note: --offline self-test only; no benchmark eval runner in evidence.

guardrails.evidence_quote: under a strict **data-safety/PII guardrail** (no destructive/state-changing actions; PII proven with a masked sample, never dumped)
guardrails.note: Non-destructive action policy + PII masking; may_assert anti-hallucination gate.

target_domain.evidence_quote: NeuroSploit is an advanced, AI-powered penetration testing framework designed to automate and augment various aspects of offensive security operations.
target_domain.note: Pentest/offensive security ('other'); white-box SAST code review (swe); web app testing.

first_release_date.note: Only v4.0.0 tag date 2026-08-23 known; first release date of the line not in evidence.

stars.note: Only a dynamic stars badge present; no numeric count in evidence.
